entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The majestic trees stood tall and proud.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The trees were joined together like a crowd of vivid green umbrellas.
entries.zh: 树木像一群生动的绿伞一样聚集在一起.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The magnificent trees flung their branches up to the sun to frame the deep blue sky.
entries.zh: 雄伟的树木把树枝伸向太阳 来描绘深蓝色的天空

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A white blanket of snowdrops danced on gusts of frosty air.
entries.zh: 白毯的雪滴在冰冻的空气中跳起

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: They were welcomed by wave after wave of the gently nodding heads of daffodils.
entries.zh: 他们受到水仙花轻轻点头的波浪的欢迎.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The ground was painted with red poppies and yellow gorse.
entries.zh: 地面上漆有红罂粟和黄果酱.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The hedge was alive with splashes of red and orange berries.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Hanging from every branch were icicles that glistened like liquid diamonds.
entries.zh: 每根树枝上吊的都是冰柱 闪闪发光的液体钻石

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The branches swayed to the rhythm of the wind and their leaves fluttered like graceful butterflies.
entries.zh: 树枝摇动着风的节奏,叶子如优雅的蝴蝶般飘荡.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The petals had been shaken off the bush and lay like a carpet of pink confetti on the floor.
entries.zh: 花瓣被从灌木丛中摇走 躺在地上就像一块粉红色的地毯

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: As they entered the wood, they were greeted by the bowed heads of a blazing carpet of bluebells.
entries.zh: 当他们进入木头的时候,他们被蓝铃毯子的弓箭头所迎接。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was impossible to move quickly through the spidery tangle of trees and bushes.
entries.zh: 无法迅速穿过林木和灌木丛的蛛丝马迹。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The brambles and thorns tore at their arms and legs.
entries.zh: 弯曲的刺伤了手臂和腿

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The forest floor was a writhing carpet of buzzing, crawling insects.
entries.zh: 森林的地板是一地毯 蜂鸣,爬虫。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: An eerie, greenish gloom filled the clearing.
entries.zh: 一片苍白的绿色阴暗 充斥着这里

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Patches of misty light shone through the gaps in the trees.
entries.zh: 雾光的片段穿过树上的缺口

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The leaves glowed in the early morning light like hundreds of tiny hands.
entries.zh: 叶子在清晨的光芒中发光,如数百只小手.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The bonfire blazed in the background. A thousand flickering shadows painted the ground.
entries.zh: 篝火在幕后燃起,千闪万闪的阴影笼罩着地面。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Rotting leaves hid the roots that wriggled across the ground.
entries.zh: 腐叶掩藏着横扫着地面的树根.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The forest was a dark, tangled maze and it was impossible to find a way through.
entries.zh: 森林是一片阴暗,缠绕的迷宫,无法找到通路.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The branches of the thick, tangled trees had spread and twisted to form dark, overhead tunnels and created secret paths.
entries.zh: 茂密,缠绕的树木的树枝已经蔓延和扭曲,形成黑暗,俯冲的隧道,并创造了秘密路径.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The ceiling of thick branches shut out the sky and covered the path in darkness.
entries.zh: 厚枝的天花板遮住了天空,在黑暗中遮蔽了道路.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The dead branches rose up and grasped at her ankles like bony fingers.
entries.zh: 枯枝起起身,像骨指一样抓住她的脚踝.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The branches twisted and grated against each other like rusty hinges.
entries.zh: 树枝相互扭曲 互相碰撞 就像生锈的铁链

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Like some prehistoric beast, the huge, twisted limbs of the tree guarded the entrance.
entries.zh: 像一些史前野兽一样,树上巨大的扭曲的四肢守卫着入口.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Pressing in on her from all sides, it seemed that the forest was trying to trap her in its thorny grasp.
entries.zh: 从四面八方向她施压 似乎森林想困住她

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: As it drifted through the forest, the fog made eerie shapes and shadows.
entries.zh: 当它漂流在森林里时, 雾会造出易怒的形状和阴影.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Cloaked in mist, the trees looked like ghostly, stooped figures.
entries.zh: 笼罩在雾中,树木看起来像幽灵般,脚踏实地的人物.
